title: Natural convection in a tall vertical slot, Boussinesq buoyancy by field_transfer (analytic)
description:
Heat + laminar flow, stationary: water between two vertical walls W = 1 mm apart (x), the hot wall x_lo at T_m + dT/2 and the cold wall x_hi at T_m - dT/2; the slot is infinitely tall (fluid periodic in y over 4 cells; heat y faces insulated). A field_transfer writes the Boussinesq buoyancy f_y = rho g beta (T - T_m) of the heat T into the fluid body_force_y slot (gravity along -y: warm fluid rises). One-way coupling: heat solves, the force is transferred, the flow marches to its steady state (no fluid_heat_convection: u . grad T = u_y dT/dy = 0 here).
Analytic (xi = x / W, fully developed, no net flow since the mean force is 0): T = T_h - dT xi, u_y = U_b xi (1 - xi)(1 - 2 xi) with U_b = rho g beta dT W^2 / (12 mu) (1.6e-3 m/s at dT = 10 K); peak |u_y| = |U_b| / (6 sqrt 3) at xi = (3 - sqrt 3) / 6 (and mirrored on the cold side).
Derived values tab: u_probe (u_y at the cell centre x = 212.5 um next to the hot-side peak), u_peak (max u_y over the cells), u_mean_norm (mean u_y / U_b, reference 0: the up- and down-flow cancel).
Line profile tab: u_profile (u_y across the slot, the antisymmetric cubic), T_profile (linear T) and force_profile (the transferred body_force_y, linear through 0 at mid-slot: checks the sign of the buoyancy), at the last sweep value dT = 10 K.
Sweep tab: u_probe and u_peak versus dT (-10..20 K; negative = hot wall on the right, the flow reverses) with the dashed closed forms.
Expected: T and body_force_y exact (~1e-6); the velocity ~1e-4..1e-3 (second-order lattice-Boltzmann with halfway bounce-back walls on 40 cells; the cubic profile is not reproduced exactly as a parabola is; float32 steady state); tolerance 3e-3.

parameters.name: dT
parameters.description: wall temperature difference T_h - T_c in K; swept (negative: hot wall on x_hi)

parameters.name: T_m
parameters.description: mean (reference) temperature in K: the buoyancy is zero there

parameters.name: T_h
parameters.description: temperature of the x_lo wall in K

parameters.name: T_c
parameters.description: temperature of the x_hi wall in K

parameters.name: mu_f
parameters.description: dynamic viscosity of water in Pa s

parameters.name: k_f
parameters.description: thermal conductivity of water in W/(m K)

parameters.name: beta_f
parameters.description: volumetric thermal expansion coefficient of water in 1/K

parameters.name: g_acc
parameters.description: gravitational acceleration in m/s^2 (magnitude; gravity along -y)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform square cell size (40 cells across the slot)

parameters.name: H_period
parameters.description: height of the periodic cell along y (the flow is uniform in y)

parameters.name: U_b
parameters.description: velocity scale of the cubic profile in m/s

parameters.name: x_p
parameters.description: probe x: the cell centre next to the hot-side peak xi = 0.2113

parameters.name: y_c
parameters.description: y of the probe and of the line profiles (a cell centre)

parameters.name: u_probe_ref
parameters.description: analytic u_y at the probe in m/s

parameters.name: u_peak_ref
parameters.description: analytic peak u_y in m/s (on the hot side, either sign of dT)
